      public final Billing.Builder phoneVerificationMethod(AbstractLocation.PhoneVerificationMethod method)

    • phoneWasVerificationSuccessful

      public final Billing.Builder phoneWasVerificationSuccessful(Boolean wasSuccessful)
      Parameters:
      wasSuccessful - Whether the most recent verification of the phone number associated with the address succeeded. Do not set this if no verification was attempted.
      Returns:
      The builder object.

    • phoneVerificationTime

      public final Billing.Builder phoneVerificationTime(ZonedDateTime time)
      Parameters:
      time - The date and time of the most recent verification of the phone number associated with the address. The time must not be before 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z or more than two days in the future. The web service ignores a time outside this range and returns a warning.
      Returns:
      The builder object.
